lec02bni-scene-u01.name: 證據固定後查詢其他節點

lec02bni-scene-u03.name: 把求和拆小並重複利用

lec02bni-scene-u04.name: 結構方向不隨查詢反轉

lec02bni-scene-u05.name: 先定拓樸再估表並注意限制

lec02bni-frame-u01.name: lec02bni-frame-u01
lec02bni-frame-u01.text: 證據固定後查詢其他節點

lec02bni-u01-1-title.name: lec02bni-u01-1-title
lec02bni-u01-1-title.text: 推論是已知幾點問其餘

lec02bni-u01-1-note9.name: lec02bni-u01-1-note9
lec02bni-u01-1-note9.text:
購物車已加入，結帳機率是多少？
Given cart activity, what is the chance of checkout?
橘色：查詢與下傳；藍色：對照與結構；青綠：訊息。

lec02bni-u01-2-title.name: lec02bni-u01-2-title
lec02bni-u01-2-title.text: 查詢須消去未觀察變數

lec02bni-u01-2-note2.name: lec02bni-u01-2-note2
lec02bni-u01-2-note2.text:
E：已觀察節點與值 / evidence；Q：想問的變數 / query。
其餘未觀察變數加總消去 / marginalize the remaining variables。

lec02bni-u01-3-title.name: lec02bni-u01-3-title
lec02bni-u01-3-title.text: 聯合分布由父節點分解

lec02bni-u01-3-cpt.name: lec02bni-u01-3-cpt
lec02bni-u01-3-cpt.text:
CPT：條件機率表
Conditional probability table
pa：父節點 / parents

lec02bni-u01-3-note4.name: lec02bni-u01-3-note4
lec02bni-u01-3-note4.text:
聯合分布寫得出來，不代表算得完。
Writing the joint distribution does not make brute-force summation affordable.

lec02bni-u01-4-motto.name: lec02bni-u01-4-motto
lec02bni-u01-4-motto.text:
網路告訴你誰與誰有關；
演算法才讓計算變快。

lec02bni-u01-4-note2.name: lec02bni-u01-4-note2
lec02bni-u01-4-note2.text:
The network tells you who is related; the algorithm computes it fast.
鏈上左右各掃一次可得條件機率。練習：二元 a→b→c，P(c|a) 要加總誰？

lec02bni-u01-5-title.name: lec02bni-u01-5-title
lec02bni-u01-5-title.text: 鏈變長組合數指數成長

lec02bni-u01-5-growth.name: growth
lec02bni-u01-5-growth.text: Binary chain: 2^(n-2) combinations; n=4 requires four combinations

image.alt: Binary chain: 2^(n-2) combinations; n=4 requires four combinations

lec02bni-u01-5-hidden.name: lec02bni-u01-5-hidden
lec02bni-u01-5-hidden.text:
x→y→z→w：P(w|x) 對 y、z 加總
Sum over y and z
$=\sum_{y,z}P(y\mid x)P(z\mid y)P(w\mid z)$
共 4 項：(y,z)=(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)
Four terms, one per pair (y,z).

lec02bni-u02-1-title.name: lec02bni-u02-1-title
lec02bni-u02-1-title.text: 每站只讀訊息與自己的表

lec02bni-u02-1-note14.name: lec02bni-u02-1-note14
lec02bni-u02-1-note14.text:
接力賽：不重跑前一棒，留下小結果重用。
Relay race: reuse the incoming message and local CPT.

lec02bni-u02-2-title.name: lec02bni-u02-2-title
lec02bni-u02-2-title.text: 各站機率由同一組表決定

lec02bni-u02-2-probability.name: probability
lec02bni-u02-2-probability.text: Prior P(x=1)=0.6; y CPT values 0.4 and 0.3

image.alt: Prior P(x=1)=0.6; y CPT values 0.4 and 0.3

lec02bni-u02-2-table.name: lec02bni-u02-2-table
lec02bni-u02-2-table.text:
P(x=1)=0.6
P(y=1|x=1)=0.4
P(y=1|x=0)=0.3
根節點用先驗 / root prior

lec02bni-u02-2-note3.name: lec02bni-u02-2-note3
lec02bni-u02-2-note3.text: 其餘二元機率取 1 減該值 / binary complements are one minus these values.

lec02bni-u02-3-title.name: lec02bni-u02-3-title
lec02bni-u02-3-title.text: 後兩站各自保留條件表

lec02bni-u02-3-cpt.name: lec02bni-u02-3-cpt
lec02bni-u02-3-cpt.text:
z=1：0.25 / 0.6
w=1：0.45 / 0.3
條件依次為父節點 1 / 0。
CPTs conditioned on parent 1 / 0.

lec02bni-u02-4-title.name: lec02bni-u02-4-title
lec02bni-u02-4-title.text: 上游證據讓訊息往下傳

lec02bni-u02-4-note13.name: lec02bni-u02-4-note13
lec02bni-u02-4-note13.text:
先讀 y 的表：P(y=1|x=1)=0.40，互補值 0.60。
Read y first. Caption rounds the last result to 0.63; calculation gives 0.631.

lec02bni-u02-5-title.name: lec02bni-u02-5-title
lec02bni-u02-5-title.text: 中介加總得到零點四六

lec02bni-u02-5-probability.name: probability
lec02bni-u02-5-probability.text:
z=0 的互補機率為 0.54。
Marginalize y; P(z=0|x=1)=0.54.

image.alt:
z=0 的互補機率為 0.54。
Marginalize y; P(z=0|x=1)=0.54.

lec02bni-u02-5-calc.name: lec02bni-u02-5-calc
lec02bni-u02-5-calc.text:
對 y 加總（全機率公式）
Sum over y (total probability)
$P(z=1\mid x=1)$
$=P(z=1\mid y=1)\,P(y=1\mid x=1)$
$\;\;+P(z=1\mid y=0)\,P(y=0\mid x=1)$
$=0.25\times0.4+0.6\times0.6$
$=0.10+0.36=0.46$

lec02bni-u02-6-title.name: lec02bni-u02-6-title
lec02bni-u02-6-title.text: 局部總和不必重算整條鏈

lec02bni-u02-6-note2.name: lec02bni-u02-6-note2
lec02bni-u02-6-note2.text:
乘進來的訊息，再對中介變數加總。
Multiply the incoming message, then sum out the intermediate variable.
根先驗 P(x)；每站自己的 CPT；Σy 消去 y。

lec02bni-u02-7-title.name: lec02bni-u02-7-title
lec02bni-u02-7-title.text: 最後一站得到零點六三一

lec02bni-u02-7-probability.name: probability
lec02bni-u02-7-probability.text:
交出去的數可快取。
Cache the outgoing result.
練習：改 P(x=1)=0.5，重算同兩個查詢。

image.alt:
交出去的數可快取。
Cache the outgoing result.
練習：改 P(x=1)=0.5，重算同兩個查詢。

lec02bni-u02-7-explain.name: lec02bni-u02-7-explain
lec02bni-u02-7-explain.text:
檢查：P(w=1|x=1)=1−0.631=0.369。
Check: P(w=1|x=1)=1−0.631=0.369.
交出去的數可快取。Cache the outgoing result.
練習：改 P(x=1)=0.5，重算同兩個查詢。

lec02bni-u02-8-title.name: lec02bni-u02-8-title
lec02bni-u02-8-title.text: 下游證據先需要邊際機率

lec02bni-u02-8-denom.name: lec02bni-u02-8-denom
lec02bni-u02-8-denom.text:
$P(w=1)=0.45\times0.474+0.3\times0.526$
$=0.2133+0.1578=0.3711$
分母保留完整精度，再計算後驗。
Keep full evidence precision for the posterior.

lec02bni-u02-9-title.name: lec02bni-u02-9-title
lec02bni-u02-9-title.text: 貝氏定理向上更新機率

lec02bni-u02-9-probability.name: probability
lec02bni-u02-9-probability.text:
再向上傳得到 P(x=0|w=1)=0.403。
Continue upstream using the same CPTs.

image.alt:
再向上傳得到 P(x=0|w=1)=0.403。
Continue upstream using the same CPTs.

lec02bni-u02-9-explain.name: lec02bni-u02-9-explain
lec02bni-u02-9-explain.text:
下兩頁繼續往 y、x 上傳。
Next: carry it upstream to y and x.

lec02bni-u02-12-title.name: lec02bni-u02-12-title
lec02bni-u02-12-title.text: 反向交棒仍重用局部結果

lec02bni-u02-12-note13.name: lec02bni-u02-12-note13
lec02bni-u02-12-note13.text:
圖說上傳序列：0.575→0.327→0.403。
同樣乘法與加總，不須重算整個聯合分布。
Evidence changes direction, not per-station cost; P(w=1) can also be cached.

lec02bni-frame-u03.name: lec02bni-frame-u03
lec02bni-frame-u03.text: 把求和拆小並重複利用

lec02bni-u03-1-note2.name: lec02bni-u03-1-note2
lec02bni-u03-1-note2.text:
乘法對加法有分配律；不含某變數的因式可移出該總和。
Distributivity lets factors independent of a variable move outside its sum.

lec02bni-u03-2-title.name: lec02bni-u03-2-title
lec02bni-u03-2-title.text: 局部消去再合併小結果

lec02bni-u03-2-note9.name: lec02bni-u03-2-note9
lec02bni-u03-2-note9.text:
像收據：先算各攤位小計，再合併，不逐張重複加。
Vendor subtotals are reused. Tree nodes: s,u,v,x,y,w,z; query P(s|z=z₀).

lec02bni-u03-3-title.name: lec02bni-u03-3-title
lec02bni-u03-3-title.text: 分解改變運算成長次方

lec02bni-u03-3-complexity.name: complexity
lec02bni-u03-3-complexity.text: Analytic L^5 and L^2 curves, log operation axis; at L=10 costs are 100000 and 100, ratio 1000

image.alt: Analytic L^5 and L^2 curves, log operation axis; at L=10 costs are 100000 and 100, ratio 1000

lec02bni-u03-3-numbers.name: lec02bni-u03-3-numbers
lec02bni-u03-3-numbers.text:
L=10
10⁵=100000
10²=100
相差 1000 倍
1000× fewer operations

lec02bni-u03-3-warning.name: lec02bni-u03-3-warning
lec02bni-u03-3-warning.text:
不是只省常數倍。
The growth order changes.

lec02bni-u03-4-title.name: lec02bni-u03-4-title
lec02bni-u03-4-title.text: 消去順序影響中間大小

lec02bni-u03-4-key.name: lec02bni-u03-4-key
lec02bni-u03-4-key.text:
求和沒有消失；
只是拆小並重複利用。

lec02bni-u03-4-note2.name: lec02bni-u03-4-note2
lec02bni-u03-4-note2.text:
Sums are broken into small reusable pieces.
消去順序改變中間因式大小；好順序需經驗與啟發式。
單一連通：任兩節點至多一條路徑，成本對節點數線性。

lec02bni-u03-5-title.name: lec02bni-u03-5-title
lec02bni-u03-5-title.text: 運算量練習須看未觀察數

lec02bni-u03-5-ct0.name: lec02bni-u03-5-ct0
lec02bni-u03-5-ct0.text:
L=10，六個未觀察變數。
暴力成本約為 10⁵ 的幾倍？
How much larger than 10⁵?

lec02bni-u03-5-ct1.name: lec02bni-u03-5-ct1
lec02bni-u03-5-ct1.text:
分解後大約是多少？
What is the factored cost?
提示：區分取值數與未觀察數。

lec02bni-u03-5-note5.name: lec02bni-u03-5-note5
lec02bni-u03-5-note5.text:
先看每個變數出現在哪些因式中，再思考加總與重用。
Inspect factor dependencies before summing and reusing results.

lec02bni-frame-u04.name: lec02bni-frame-u04
lec02bni-frame-u04.text: 結構方向不隨查詢反轉

lec02bni-u04-1-title.name: lec02bni-u04-1-title
lec02bni-u04-1-title.text: 結構邊與訊息箭頭不同

lec02bni-u04-1-kind220.name: lec02bni-u04-1-kind220
lec02bni-u04-1-kind220.text: Structural edges / 結構邊：固定向右

lec02bni-u04-1-kind460.name: lec02bni-u04-1-kind460
lec02bni-u04-1-kind460.text: Query messages / 查詢訊息：向左

lec02bni-u04-1-note25.name: lec02bni-u04-1-note25
lec02bni-u04-1-note25.text:
觀察 w=1 只固定證據；不改變生成機制。
Conditioning changes computation order, not structural edges.

lec02bni-u04-2-title.name: lec02bni-u04-2-title
lec02bni-u04-2-title.text: 兩種查詢共用同一張網路

lec02bni-u04-2-note14.name: lec02bni-u04-2-note14
lec02bni-u04-2-note14.text:
Same network, same CPTs; different evidence and message direction.
P(x=0|w=1)=0.403 是條件化，不是反轉結構。

lec02bni-u04-3-title.name: lec02bni-u04-3-title
lec02bni-u04-3-title.text: 反轉結構不是原本的查詢

lec02bni-u04-3-kind180.name: lec02bni-u04-3-kind180
lec02bni-u04-3-kind180.text: ✓ 結構不變 / Keep structural edges

lec02bni-u04-3-kind420.name: lec02bni-u04-3-kind420
lec02bni-u04-3-kind420.text: ✗ 因證據反轉結構 / Wrong: reverse edges because of evidence

lec02bni-u04-3-note25.name: lec02bni-u04-3-note25
lec02bni-u04-3-note25.text:
原文警告：翻轉成另一模型與生成機制，非原網路查詢。
Do not confuse causal direction with inference direction.

lec02bni-u04-4-title.name: lec02bni-u04-4-title
lec02bni-u04-4-title.text: 觀察結果不會讓因果倒流

lec02bni-u04-4-motto.name: lec02bni-u04-4-motto
lec02bni-u04-4-motto.text:
觀察不反轉因果；
只改變從哪裡開始算。

lec02bni-u04-4-note2.name: lec02bni-u04-4-note2
lec02bni-u04-4-note2.text:
Observing an effect changes where computation starts.
觀察與干預需另一套語言，例如 do-算子，不能只翻轉箭頭。
練習：證據在 w 就把結構改成 w→z，錯在哪？

lec02bni-frame-u05.name: lec02bni-frame-u05
lec02bni-frame-u05.text: 先定拓樸再估表並注意限制

lec02bni-u05-1-title.name: lec02bni-u05-1-title
lec02bni-u05-1-title.text: 訓練先定拓樸再估機率表

lec02bni-u05-1-note9.name: lec02bni-u05-1-note9
lec02bni-u05-1-note9.text:
相關組合的出現頻率估計條件機率。
Estimate CPTs from training frequencies.
少樣本不穩定：常加平滑或貝氏估計 / smoothing or Bayesian estimation.

lec02bni-u05-2-title.name: lec02bni-u05-2-title
lec02bni-u05-2-title.text: 多重連通精確推論一般很難

lec02bni-u05-2-ct0.name: lec02bni-u05-2-ct0
lec02bni-u05-2-ct0.text:
單一連通 / singly connected
任兩節點至多一條路徑。
成本對節點數線性。
樹狀或 Naive Bayes 可保持快。

lec02bni-u05-2-ct1.name: lec02bni-u05-2-ct1
lec02bni-u05-2-ct1.text:
多重連通 / multiply connected
一般精確推論是 NP-hard。
數十節點密集相連可能慢到不可用。
Approximation trades accuracy for speed.

lec02bni-u05-2-note5.name: lec02bni-u05-2-note5
lec02bni-u05-2-note5.text:
NP-hard 不代表貝氏網路無用；拓樸設計能保留實用性。
Hard general cases do not make Bayesian networks useless.

lec02bni-u05-3-title.name: lec02bni-u05-3-title
lec02bni-u05-3-title.text: 近似推論有兩大類方法

lec02bni-u05-3-ct0.name: lec02bni-u05-3-ct0
lec02bni-u05-3-ct0.text:
蒙地卡羅取樣
Monte Carlo sampling

lec02bni-u05-3-ct1.name: lec02bni-u05-3-ct1
lec02bni-u05-3-ct1.text:
變分法
Variational methods
放寬成可解的問題。

lec02bni-u05-3-ct2.name: lec02bni-u05-3-ct2
lec02bni-u05-3-ct2.text:
練習 / Practice
先定拓樸再估 CPT，為何簡單？
提示：兩階段的最佳化目標。

lec02bni-u05-3-note7.name: lec02bni-u05-3-note7
lec02bni-u05-3-note7.text:
原文以取樣與變分法說明近似推論；不另加演算法細節。
Sampling and variational methods are the two source families.

lec02bni-u05-4-title.name: lec02bni-u05-4-title
lec02bni-u05-4-title.text: 記住證據訊息與求和三件事

lec02bni-u05-4-summary.name: lec02bni-u05-4-summary
lec02bni-u05-4-summary.text:
固定證據，查詢其餘；
逐站交棒，拆小求和；
訊息可反向，結構不反向。

lec02bni-u05-4-note2.name: lec02bni-u05-4-note2
lec02bni-u05-4-note2.text:
Evidence · query · CPT · marginalization · variable elimination
Message passing · factored summation · chain / tree network
Downstream / upstream message · causal direction · approximate inference

lec02bni-u02-10-title.name: lec02bni-u02-10-title
lec02bni-u02-10-title.text: 上傳到 y：先換向再對 z 加總

lec02bni-u02-10-note.name: lec02bni-u02-10-note
lec02bni-u02-10-note.text:
w 只透過 z 影響 y（鏈上 y⊥w | z），所以可以這樣加總。
w affects y only through z (y ⟂ w given z), so the sum over z is valid.

lec02bni-u02-11-title.name: lec02bni-u02-11-title
lec02bni-u02-11-title.text: 上傳到 x 得到零點四零三

lec02bni-u02-11-note.name: lec02bni-u02-11-note
lec02bni-u02-11-note.text:
同一組 CPT，方向相反：上傳序列 0.575 → 0.327 → 0.403。
Same CPTs, opposite direction: the upstream sequence is 0.575 → 0.327 → 0.403.
